goal: Validate command-line argument types and reject duplicate non-list config settings during startup
Prevent configuration parsing footguns and silent bugs caused by unexpected type coercion
agreement: General support for typed argument validation, but one answered objection awaits reviewer response

Concept approval for incremental argument typing and cleaner error handling (hodlinator, laanwj, l0rinc)
